pilot_selection: Existing six complete 100-frame Cellpose/ultrack clips, frozen before this reassessment; reused exploratory data, not new validation.

legacy_control.nodes_candidates_calibration_decoder: Identical to the corresponding frozen v5 H_general_J inputs; no refitting. Compare both modes in CPU FP32.
legacy_control.coordinate_conversion: Model positions and diameter /1.625; inertia /1.625^2. Output coordinates, physical context, border/intensity features unchanged.
legacy_control.scope: Isolates unit conversion; inherited C0 detections, structural prior, protected links and decoder remain exposed. Not full upstream pipeline.

cellpose.observations: Every instance in the unchanged raw native Cellpose masks; rounded native centroids for the metric; unrounded voxel centroids for HOCT.
cellpose.features: Actual native voxel regionprops; upstream per-frame 0.999 quantile intensity normalization and five-voxel border feature.
cellpose.candidates: Union of eight nearest incoming and outgoing candidates within 15 micrometers, adjacent frames only, independent of baseline edges and labels.
cellpose.probability: Upstream median exp(logits) over contextual windows, normalized over all candidate parents plus learned orphan exp(logit).
cellpose.division_control: A separately reported no-division control for each model; never a claimed mitosis solution.
cellpose.calibration: No Biohub labels or old probe coefficients in initial standalone inference.

evaluation: Freeze graphs before fresh official scoring; report whole-panel and per-embryo edge/division TP/FP/FN, node counts and exact aggregated full metric. Never average clip scores.
exposure: Legacy arms inherit known public-training overlap. Cellpose and HOCT use external frozen weights with unverified exact training lists; no clean-generalization claim. Source-only fitting, if added, must be a separate locked stage.
preservation: Separate output namespace; do not modify or interrupt other experiments. No baseline replacement or submission.
